init.title: 1FuseLoader options
init.description: Tune thresholds. Current settings are checked together before saving. Unused phases stay at 0 A. TTL values are seconds; Easee receives rounded-up whole minutes. {error} Current decreases immediately and increases gradually after stable headroom. The minimum-current reserve applies at the configured minimum current; the normal buffer applies at higher charging current. Experimental timed overload is off by default. When enabled, the minimum current may continue above the fuse rating within a cumulative budget, after a separate short response window. These settings do not establish the installation's allowable overload or replace physical protection. Short dips, setting changes and restarts do not replenish the budget. This release provides no automatic budget reset or user reset button. Start/restart current is separate from the running minimum and requires the full normal buffer. The effective offer is bounded by the configured car min/max. It is not a short current pulse and does not resume a manual pause or override a vehicle schedule.

data.startup_charge_amps: Start/restart current (A, bounded by car min/max)
data.overload_margin_amps: Experimental sustained overload above main fuse (A, maximum 4)
data.overload_transition_limit_amps: Experimental peak limit during response window (A, maximum 38)
data.overload_response_seconds: Experimental response window after requesting minimum current (seconds, maximum 10)
